Though I have no direct suggestions, I would like to start this discussion and branch from the ongoing conversation about Voting Limitations.

A possible non-issue I've encountered (here and) is a situation of "First Come, Only Serve," where the first into a discussion become a part of the discussion and most of the rest are kicked to the bottom — never to be seen or regarded. In my opinion, this impacts the efficiency of the Contribution Point limits, and it may have to do with something as simple as the way the 'Sort By' function is presented, kicking new posts to the bottom where the majority will mostly never think to look.

Though I'm more of a lurker than a contributor, it makes me feel even more excluded that my (or other's) contributions may never be regarded. As I said though, I may be discussing a non-issue here and simply didn't know where to go to find some thoughts on the matter; so here I am. Is it nothing to be concerned about?

(edit) TL;DR — Assuming first posters get the most up-voats, it may drown out newer comments.

I don´t think the problem here is Voat (or Reddit), but its users. I mean every user has the possibility to sort his comments by new, and see the newest comments first. So, to chance this, you would have to change the Voat/Reddit user attitude, which is really really difficult.
